items.problem: SKILL.md tells the agent the anchor list 'lives in unsupported-api-inventory.json under each entry's anchor', but that JSON only enumerates the unsupported-API anchors — it does not list the manifest/csproj/analyzer anchors the agent needs, so the agent has no canonical list of fetchable anchors and resorts to guessing.
items.evidence: session-log turns 18-20 show the agent guessing 'manifest', 'manifest-migration-checklist', 'appxmanifest' with no authoritative anchor list to consult. Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 header comment: 'The full list lives in unsupported-api-inventory.json under each entry's anchor.'
items.covered_at: scripts/Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 .PARAMETER Anchor comment + SKILL.md references to -Anchor.
items.proposed_improvement: This gap is fully absorbed by the skill-defect fix: once Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 prints the available anchors+headings on a miss, the agent always has a live, authoritative list and never needs the (incomplete) JSON pointer. No separate edit required beyond the defect fix.
items.generalizes: Any scenario whose needed section isn't one of the unsupported-API anchors hits the same missing-list problem; the on-miss listing solves it universally.
